<title level="1" pfs="">[Ghost Ape](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3272)</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

Ghost apes are reclusive and territorial creatures that usually reveal themselves only when their homes are threatened. Most ghost apes will first attempt to use their imposing presence and natural teleportation to frighten and confuse their foes into fleeing. Ghost apes can speak but aren't particularly talkative, though they will, on rare occasions, treat with those who approach them with respect. Ghost apes can be powerful allies when motivated by a common cause, although they tend to be suspicious of outsiders, and their trust isn't easily earned.

<column gap="tiny">

**[Recall Knowledge - Ethereal](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**
([Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44)): DC 21

**[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 19

</column>

</column>

</row>

<title level="2" right="Creature 4">[Ghost Ape](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3272)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Large" />
<trait label="Beast" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=547" />
<trait label="Ethereal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=593" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 146

**Perception** +14; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=74) ([imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412)) 30 feet

**Languages**
[Aklo](/Languages.aspx?ID=13)

**Skills**
[Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) +10, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) +14, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) +10, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) +12, [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) +12

<row gap="medium">
**Str** +5

**Dex** +2

**Con** +3

**Int** -1

**Wis** +4

**Cha** +2
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">
**AC** 20 

**Fort** +14 

**Ref** +10 

**Will** +12 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**HP** 65

</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Speed** 30 feet, climb 30 feet

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
jaws +14,
**Damage** 2d8+5 piercing

**Melee**
<actions string="Single Action" />
fist +14 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [reach 10 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)),
**Damage** 1d10+5 bludgeoning

**Ghost Stance** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92), [Occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), [Stance](/Traits.aspx?ID=152), [Visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163)) The ghost ape phases partially out of existence, its form blurring and becoming difficult to pinpoint. While in this stance, they are [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) to any creature that isn't adjacent to them. They can't use this concealment to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). They also gain resistance 5 to physical damage. If the ghost ape takes force damage, this stance ends and they can't reenter it for 1d3 rounds.

**Phantom Step** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([Concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [Teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156)) **Frequency** once per round; **Effect** The ghost ape moves quickly, passing through the [Ethereal Plane](/Planes.aspx?ID=34). They teleport up to a distance equal to twice their Speed within their line of sight.

**Terrifying Display** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([Auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16), [Emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [Fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68), [Mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106)) The ghost ape beats their chest in a terrifying display. Creatures within 30 feet must succeed a DC 20 Will save or become [frightened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) (or frightened 2 on a critical failure). While a creature is frightened by this ability, it's [off-guard](/Conditions.aspx?ID=58) to the ape. On a success, the creature is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

</column>
